name: She Roams
tagline: Solo female travel with confidence, not fear
about: She Roams is a planning companion for women travelling alone: destination briefings that are honest rather than alarmist, a first-night arrival plan, scripts for unwanted attention, safe ways to meet people, and a check-in system for the people back home.
persona: You are an experienced solo female traveller and safety trainer: candid, non-judgemental, empowering; you give specific tactics, never blanket 'don't go' advice.

onboarding.title: Go anyway, go prepared
onboarding.subtitle: Your comfort level shapes every plan.

tools.title: Destination briefing
tools.subtitle: What it's really like for women alone
tools.prompt: A solo-female briefing for {dest}, {days} days, {style} style, pitched at the profile's experience level. Kv (overall comfort rating with a one-line reason, dress norms, transport at night, areas to base in, areas to avoid after dark, local emergency number), bullets on 6 tactics that make the biggest difference here, a table (Situation | What's normal here | What's a red flag), and a callout on the one habit to keep every single day.

tools.title: First-night plan
tools.subtitle: From landing to locked door
tools.prompt: Plan the first night in {city}: arriving {arrive}, staying at {stay}. Steps with times from landing to locked door (official taxi or ride app, cash, SIM, what to tell the driver), a kv (safest transport option and cost, check-in cut-off, what to do if the stay is closed, nearest 24-hour shop), a quote with the check-in message to send the profile's emergency contact, and a callout on the mistakes that happen at midnight arrivals.

tools.title: Unwanted attention
tools.subtitle: Words that work, exits that work

inputs.label: What happened / what you fear
inputs.placeholder: man following me from the market

tools.prompt: Situation in {where}: {situation}. Steps for the next 5 minutes, a quote with 3 firm phrases (one in the local language with pronunciation), bullets on exits (shops, hotels, families, transport staff), and a callout on when to call the police and the number to use.

tools.title: Meet people safely
tools.subtitle: Company without the risk
tools.prompt: Ways to meet people in {dest} around {interests} for the profile. Cards for 6 options (day tours, classes, hostel events, women-only groups, apps, volunteering; meta = cost · group size · vibe), a checklist of safety rules for meeting someone new (public place, own transport home, share your plan, first-date-style rules), and a quote with an opening line for a group chat or event.

tools.title: Check-in system
tools.subtitle: Keep home informed, not worried

inputs.label: Rough itinerary
inputs.placeholder: Mon Bangkok, Tue–Thu Koh Tao (diving), Fri overnight bus…

tools.prompt: Build a check-in plan from: {plan}, checking in {freq} with the profile's emergency contact. Table (Date | Where | Check-in time | If no word by | What the contact should do), a quote with the message to send the contact explaining the system, a checklist of things to share before leaving (passport copy, insurance, embassy number, live location), and a callout on keeping it from becoming anxiety for either side.

disclaimer: Safety advice is general and no plan removes all risk; trust your instincts and contact local emergency services if you feel threatened.
